name: Dead-log detector (one ALERTS line when a log a prompt or report reads has no line past 3x its cadence)

knobs.note: BH-8417: a log listed in catalog/log-freshness.d/ is stale when its newest stamped line (else its mtime) is older than this many times its expected cadence; a stale log is ONE ALERTS line per (log, stale-since day) naming the owning lane. Read by bin/log-freshness.sh as ${LOG_FRESHNESS_MULT:-3}; outside 1..100 is one warn line in logs/log-freshness.log and the default.

BH-8417: days a state/log-freshness/alerted-<log>-<yyyymmdd> dedup marker is kept (by mtime); older markers are deleted every run, so a log that stays dead is alerted again once this many days later. Read by bin/log-freshness.sh as ${LOG_FRESHNESS_KEEP_D:-7}; outside 1..365 is one warn line and the default.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/log-freshness.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/log-freshness.sh honours LOG_FRESHNESS_NOW only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
